adaptationSummary: Adapted for getsentry/sentry (default profile): per-slot Django (sentry devserver --no-watchers on API_PORT) + rsbuild dev server (FE_PORT) via PM2; shared Postgres 14 (template_sentry migrated with sentry upgrade -> dev admin/org/project) and Redis 7 (fixed port 16479, per-slot DB index); scripts/sentry-slot.sh for install (uv sync + devenv-pinned Node 26 + pnpm install), env-driven SENTRY_CONF, migrate, changed-files and login/API/UI smoke; eager tasks (no Kafka/Snuba); stages: django check, health, UI proxy (quick) + prek/oxlint, related pytest (per-slot test DBs/Redis, snuba-only tests skipped), typecheck + direct jest specs, readiness smoke (full); post-teardown hook drops pytest DBs; agentSlots.max=3.
